title: 2008 AMC 12B Problem 8
statement: Points \(B\) and \(C\) lie on \(\overline{AD}.\) The length of \(\overline{AB}\) is \(4\) times the length of \(\overline{BD},\) and the length of \(\overline{AC}\) is \(9\) times the length of \(\overline{CD}.\) The length of \(\overline{BC}\) is what fraction of the length of \(\overline{AD}?\)

solutions.text:
Since \(AB = 4\,BD\) and \(AB + BD = AD,\) we have \(5\,BD = AD,\) so \(BD = \tfrac{1}{5}AD.\)

Likewise \(AC = 9\,CD\) with \(AC + CD = AD\) gives \(CD = \tfrac{1}{10}AD.\)

Because \(B\) and \(C\) both measure from \(A,\) \(\;BC = BD - CD\) \(= \tfrac{1}{5}AD - \tfrac{1}{10}AD\) \(= \tfrac{1}{10}AD.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
